My research focuses on microbial diversity, extremophiles, Antarctic ecosystems, lichen symbioses, molecular ecology and cyanobacterial adaptation. My work combines microbiology, molecular biology, microscopy, phylogenetics, genomics and bioinformatics. ### 2025 **De Carolis, R.**, Stoppiello, G.A., Turchetti, B., Bartolomeo, G., Coleine, C., Tretiach, M., ... & Muggia, L. **Cryptic associated fungi and algae isolated from Antarctic epilithic lichens of the Victoria Land and the description of five new fungal species.** *Persoonia – Molecular Phylogeny and Evolution of Fungi*, **55**(1), 439–476. **DOI:** 10.3114/persoonia.2025.55.11
